title: The Care Delivery funds are described: one active under $1M, one in formation
summary: Care Delivery Fund I is an active fund under $1M that incubates ten companies and programs, and Fund II is in formation, explored at $25M to $50M.
text: Fund I incubates OurHakeem, Payshent, Medigy Opportunity Atlas, Medigy Demand Intelligence, PatientTeam.com, Neuvist, Symvion, Revenue Acceleration, the Ambient Biomarkers Reference Lab and Continuous Care OS. Fund II is in formation to develop clinician-led care delivery companies: creating, acquiring, holding or spinning them out as the business requires. Each fund has its own page with the thesis and how it works.
